name: uniq
purpose: Filter out or count adjacent duplicate lines in sorted text.
explanation: Removes repeated adjacent lines. Because `uniq` only checks neighbouring lines, input is almost always sorted first with `sort`.

parameters.description: Prefix each unique line with its occurrence count.

explanationOfOutput: Groups identical sorted lines and shows how many times each occurred.
whenToUse: To deduplicate or count repeated lines in logs or lists.
commonMistakes: Running `uniq` on unsorted input and wondering why non-adjacent duplicates remain.
commonErrors: uniq: file: No such file or directory
